title: shutil.rmtree() cannot remove directory trees deeper than MAX_PATH on Windows

title: shutil.rmtree() fails with "Too many open files" on deep directory trees
author: serhiy-storchaka
body_preview: The fd-based implementation of `shutil.rmtree()` (used on Linux, macOS and other POSIX platforms) keeps a file descriptor open for every level of the directory tree, until the whole subtree is removed.
